name: A Friend in Need
summary: Iverron lies bitten and in danger in Shadowglen. The young night elf calls for Dirania Silvershine, whose help may save him from Githyiss the Vile's venom.

sections.title: A Reckless Venture
sections.body: Iverron lies weakened after a bite from Githyiss the Vile. He ignored warnings and went too near the webwood caverns, where the vicious spider struck. Dizziness and failing strength leave him unable to reach safety alone.

sections.title: A Call to Aldrassil
sections.body: Iverron sends passersby toward Aldrassil's central tree to find Dirania Silvershine. She looks out for him and knows the dangers of Shadowglen. His life may depend on her preparing an antidote before the venom proves fatal.

aliases: who gives a friend in need
faq.answer: Iverron is a young night elf who lives in Shadowglen, within Teldrassil. He often wanders into danger despite his companions' warnings, and Githyiss the Vile has left him near death.
Githyiss the Vile bit Iverron. The highly poisonous spider lurks inside a spider cave in Shadowglen.

aliases: who to talk to for iverron
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine is a night elf who lives at Aldrassil in Shadowglen. She is Iverron's close friend and guardian figure, and knows how to treat venomous injuries.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
aliases: where is a friend in need
faq.answer: The events take place entirely in Shadowglen, the night elves' sheltered vale high on Teldrassil's crown.

faq.q: What happens after reporting Iverron's condition to Dirania?
aliases: what next after a friend in need
faq.answer: After hearing of Iverron's condition, Dirania begins preparing a remedy. She sends adventurers across the grove to gather rare reagents for an antidote before the poison kills him.

faq.q: Why are there deadly spiders inside Shadowglen?
aliases: why are there spiders in shadowglen
faq.answer: Shadowglen shelters young night elves, but corruption spreading across Teldrassil has stirred wild beasts and vermin, including webwood spiders, into unusually aggressive and venomous predators.

angles.text: As a young kaldorei beginning your training beneath Aldrassil, you can see that even Shadowglen's sheltered boughs hold corruption and deadly peril.
As a druid, you learn early that imbalanced wildlife can strike down the unwary, and that understanding and countering nature's venoms matters.
